# Fog light bulb replacement and housing removal

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove fog light assembly to access bulb via housing bolts and retaining pins. [t1859]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the fog light assembly from the bumper.
2. Locate a small hex bolt on the bottom left of the housing (driver's side view).
3. Loosen and remove that hex bolt completely using a socket.
4. [Partial] Push in two retaining pins located at the top of the housing to release them.
5. [Partial] Remove the bulb from inside the now-exposed housing.

_Procedure reported by [t1859]._

## Tools

- Socket wrench (for small hex bolt) [t1859]
- Phillips screwdriver [t1859]
- [Partial] Hammer or palm for tapping [t1859]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Ensure the main housing is fully removed from the bumper before attempting to access internal components. [t1859]
- [Partial] If a Phillips head struggles on the retaining pins, use a flat screwdriver and tap it with your palm for better leverage. [t1859]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Stopping halfway through loosening the bottom hex bolt instead of removing it entirely. [t1859]
